name: Alchemist Formulae (3pp)
body:
1st-Level Alchemist Formulae (Third Party Publishers)
Formula Name	Comp.	Description	Source
Cover Scent		Makes it more difficult to track with scent, –2 penalty to odor-based special attacks.	BoM: SS1
Detect Alchemy		As detect poison, but it detects objects created through alchemy and alchemical reagents rather than magic.	SGG:110SV
2nd-Level Alchemist Formulae (Third Party Publishers)
Formula Name	Comp.	Description	Source
Adaptive Admix		As resist energy, but the resistance gained applies to the first of the following damage types you are affected by each round: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic.	SGG:110SV
Night Shield		Shadow forms into shield that deflects ranged attacks, blocks magic missiles.	AG:PS
Rostov’s Poison Fang		Your natural weapons become poisonous weapons.	BoM: SS1
3rd-Level Alchemist Formulae (Third Party Publishers)
Formula Name	Comp.	Description	Source

4th-Level Alchemist Formulae (Third Party Publishers)
Formula Name	Comp.	Description	Source
Cover Scent, Greater		Cannot track with scent, odor-based special attacks are negated.	BoM: SS1
Night Armor		Shadow forms into armor that grants DR 5/silver and deflects ranged attacks.	AG:PS
Riyal’s Ectoplasmic Shield		Incorporeal creatures attacking you take force damage.	BoM: SS1
Shadow Form		Subject becomes a natural shadow.	AG:PS
Typhoid Tonic		As contagion, except for the spell’s duration you can infect targets (as contagion ) with a touch attack .	SGG:110SV
5th-Level Alchemist Formulae (Third Party Publishers)
Formula Name	Comp.	Description	Source

6th-Level Alchemist Formulae (Third Party Publishers)
Formula Name	Comp.	Description	Source
Black Blood		As poison, except that creatures that hit you with natural or unarmed attacks are affected as by the poison spell.	SGG:110SV
